name: blubberize
title: blubberize
blurb: Bluesky but every account is a seal, sized by real followersCount. type your handle and a target's, hit FISSION, and projectile off half your blubber to render them BLUBBERIZED (unable to post — cosmetically, not really). @norvid-studies.bsky.social riffed on gracekind.net's "every account is a seal sized by followers" post with the fission mechanic.
